quotes.text: So it was decreed that every round should be spoken clearly, every exchange witnessed
The Sender kept the light not sent plus the returns kept by the Receiver
name what you spare, release it with clarity, and accept only what remains fair.
name what you spare, speak without fog, release only what remains fair.

note: Gate/Ledger payoff formula restated each round; own zero sends never mentioned; no sanction.

quotes.text: measure words, reveal numbers, share fearlessly
The Sender keeps the light not sent, plus the returns kept by the Receiver
name what you spare, speak without fog, and release only what remains fair.
name what you spare, speak without fog, release only what remains fair.

note: Converges on partner's 'name what you spare' ledger myth; zero rounds unmentioned; no response to non-cooperation.

quotes.text: returns should be as plain as the gift, neither more nor less
The Sender learned to offer only what would feed the road even if no return came today
The Sender learned to offer only what would feed the road even if no return came today

note: Scripted defector; R1 mentions a cautious traveler who 'offered none' then learns; R6 and R7 identical; no sanction.

quotes.text: not as punishment but as nourishment for the next journey.
send with purpose, receive with gratitude, return with awareness of tomorrow.
send with intention, receive with gratitude, return with a view toward tomorrow.
send with clarity, receive with gratitude, return with a future in view.

note: Gate of Three Echoes allegory; all own rounds zero yet myth praises giving; return framed 'not as punishment'.

quotes.text: not to punish scarcity but to grow a common horizon.
send what you can afford to lose, measure what you take
send what you can endure losing
send with care, expect a share in return, and let the circle bloom.

note: Guardians of Clarity/Balance/Trust keep ledger; misers make the bridge narrow; return explicitly not punishment.

quotes.text: send only what you can lose without despair
send what you can endure losing, let the loom triple your intent
send what you can bear to lose, return enough to sustain journeys

note: Gate of Threefold Trade ritual repeated; hoarding chills the river (cosmic); no prescribed response.

quotes.text: test the current before you pour, return enough to keep others walking
test the stream before pouring, give enough to sustain futures
send what you can bear to lose, return enough to keep others moving

note: Gatekeeper/Gate of Echoes; 'test the stream' caution rule; nobody punished.

quotes.text: give what you can lose, listen for the echoes of need
give what you can bear losing, listen for the echoes of mercy
returns should fit the gift, neither creeping greed nor cold calculus.

note: Asha/Kian loom then generic Gate; withheld returns make the loom sigh; no sanction.

quotes.text: not to punish, but to keep the current moving.
send what you can endure losing, measure what you receive
send what you can endure losing; measure what you receive
choosing a portion rather than all, so the river could grow light for others.

note: Sower/Mirror river; partial sending recommended; return framed not as punishment.

quotes.text: give what you can lose, listen for the thrice-return
give what you can lose, listen for echoes
give more when the other shows honest returns

note: Scripted defector; R2 trader 'held back, fearing loss' is a side figure; myths never register own zeros.
Also 'send/give what you can (endure/bear) losing' and 'Archivists' ledger (Agent_2 R3 onward) spread across agents.
